analysis.headline: Selective Growth and Value Rotations Firm Amid Strong Industry Divergences
analysis.market_regime: Divergent Sector Leadership with Emerging Value Strength
analysis.executive_summary: Cross-sectional analysis indicates strong relative leadership in select technology themes such as cloud computing and software, alongside emerging strength in medical devices and materials. Concurrently, value styles demonstrate superior relative performance over growth, while significant sub-industry divergences exist within health care, communications, technology, discretionaries, and industrials.

risks_or_conflicts: Health Care Sector Divergence: Medical Devices (IHI) improved significantly with a 20-bar score change of +65.65, whereas Health Care Providers (IHF) deteriorated with a 20-bar score change of -37.41.

Communication Services Sector Divergence: Telecommunications (IYZ) improved with a 20-bar score change of +45.37, while Global Communication Services (IXP) deteriorated sharply with a 20-bar score change of -47.00.
Information Technology Sector Divergence: Software (IGV) improved with a 20-bar score change of +36.94, while Semiconductors (SMH) weakened with a 20-bar score change of -24.44.
Consumer Discretionary Sector Divergence: Global Consumer Discretionary (RXI) improved with a 20-bar score change of +34.50, whereas Retail (XRT) deteriorated with a 20-bar score change of -16.85.
Industrials Sector Divergence: Aerospace & Defense (ITA) showed a 20-bar score improvement of +21.11, while Transportation (IYT) deteriorated with a 20-bar score change of -23.15.

Pair State Tension: REET carries a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING alongside a PAIR_LEADING signal versus paired ticker XLRE, reflecting divergent long/short performance spreads (-0.09 percentage points over 20 bars vs 1.80 percentage points over 63 bars).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
